authorization: User explicitly requested evaluation, incorporation of regional-observability engineering objective, and experiments. This supersedes old discussion recommendations against starting experiments.
scope: Mechanism feasibility screen, not confirmatory validation, original-V1a replacement, or publication claim

regional_model.gain: Nominal steady aggregate common-G MMSE design, matching existing measurement-sum interface
regional_model.reason: Local and trusted-neighbor channels miss the second unstable mode; suspicious sender 0 supplies it. Original frozen H matrices are not changed.

candidate_parameters: Both active candidates use the predeclared ordinary direction (-1.89,0.42), normalized separately per model to coded energy 10. The finite bank knows this waveform direction and amplitude; this is a favorable model-matched mechanism diagnostic, NOT unknown-amplitude V1a or general A0 validation.
history: Same original Gaussian watermark prefix and same observed prefix for all current-step comparisons; fixed candidate likelihoods use a Kalman filter per hypothesis, preserving process/measurement correlations. No true label enters policy selection.
primary_comparison: One-step conditional Bayes risk under equal expected candidate-state dispersion, versus uniform directions; actual conditional common-G compensation risk separately scored
fixed_comparator: One constant v selected on development histories by average information objective, average dispersion equality and average healthy budget; evaluation dispersion is reported. This is not best fixed closed-loop optimization.
healthy_allowance_reference: Current conditional uniform common-G compensation MSE, not the historical V1a nominal-2-percent certificate
refinement_histories: Evaluation path 16, all three true candidates, tick 8, all models; compare coefficients and risk of the same chosen policy
engineering_replay: 32 regional trajectories; compare always-discard, raw common-G, finite-bank compensated common-G, and ideal finite-bank Bayes. All use the same Gaussian watermark; active design is screened separately at shared histories. Therefore this replay alone establishes no adaptive-watermark closed-loop gain.
no_tuning: No post-screen direction, energy, rho, seed, threshold or gain search. Report zero, negative, healthy-infeasible and numerically unresolved cases.
